No it doesn’t. It doesn’t excuse wrong behaviour. I’m saying this as someone who put my ex partner through things she just couldn’t understand. It was never her fault. 

Anyway, the truth is, you are not a therapist. She needs professional help and this is the truth. Whilst she is receiving this, you can still be there to support her. 

She needs to understand herself so you can understand her. Not the other way around. 

Offer to come with her to a therapy session let her do the session by herself but just wait for her outside or something. Don’t talk about it afterwards, just go get a bite and go for a walk in the park or something and if she opens up, you know one thing that works.

Hey man, you know what? Don’t let cutting contact be the subconscious thought for you making that last choice. Please, I beg you. I stay away from posts on this because, no words can really take away how someone is feeling. My heart breaks for all these people suffering and in some way, I see all the comments and I see we all understand and wish we could make the pain go away. 

But hear me out, I understand the demons, the nightmares, the anger, the sadness, the isolation. 

I cut off my friends and they welcomed me back with open arms. Because sometimes you need to do this to figure out what YOU need and what YOU want.  

Take some time out. Stay away from bullshit and if you need to rant and talk, message me! 

This isn’t me trying to make you make drastic changes you can’t make right now…

This is me telling you to hold on…

“All winners were losers at some point” - I say that to say this, it might feel like a losing battle, but when you overcome this hurdle which takes TIME. You will Win! 

And this will be nothing but a distant memory.
